## Activity

During February 2022, Market Eye Clinic recorded 314 captures. Activity was completed through the scheduled site operations, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded volume provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 14 were assessed as ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 4.5 per cent. The result identifies the images that could not be used for grading and should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for the month. No further operational issue was recorded in relation to image quality.

## Grading

Grading identified 58 referable results. The median lag from photograph capture to completion of grading was 15 days. This measure reflects the typical interval between image capture and the grading outcome. Together, the referable findings and the reported median lag provide a summary of grading activity for the month.
